PATCH /admin/complaints/{id}/status – IN_REVIEW / ESCALATED / REJECTED (reason required)

POST /admin/complaints/{id}/resolve – Resolve with an outcome

request.description: REFUND creates a refund request (approved in the refund queue); WARNING notifies the party; SUSPENSION suspends it and also requires users.manage.

GET /admin/delivery/zones – Delivery zones

PATCH /admin/delivery/zones/{id} – Activate / deactivate a zone
GET /admin/delivery/fee-rules – Delivery fee rules
POST /admin/delivery/fee-rules – Create a fee rule (base + per km, clamped to [min, max])
PATCH /admin/delivery/fee-rules/{id} – Update / deactivate a fee rule (audited before/after)
GET /admin/delivery/settings – Delivery timeouts and limits
PATCH /admin/delivery/settings – Change delivery timeouts / limits (reason required; history kept)

GET /admin/medicines – Medicines (incl. inactive)
POST /admin/medicines – Create a medicine

request.description: Header: brand_name*, category*, name_ar, inn_dci, form, dosage, pack_size, manufacturer, requires_prescription, reimbursable_flag, regulatory_code. Returns a line report; dry_run=true validates only.

item.name: PATCH /admin/medicines/{id} – Update a medicine (audited before/after)

GET /admin/requests/{id} – Request metadata: recipients, offers (totals only), counts
GET /admin/requests/{id}/content – Prescription items, files and Chifa data of a request

request.description: Requires an active REQUEST grant (POST /admin/sensitive-access), otherwise 403 SENSITIVE_ACCESS_GRANT_REQUIRED. Every read is logged.

item.name: GET /admin/orders – Orders – amounts, statuses, parties (no item names)

GET /admin/conversations/{id}/messages – Messages of a conversation – requires an active CONVERSATION grant; logged
POST /admin/sensitive-access – Open a time-limited grant to sensitive content

request.description: Justification ≥ 20 characters. Valid for sensitive_access_grant_minutes (default 30). Recorded in sensitive_access_logs.

DELETE /admin/sensitive-access/{id} – Close one of my grants early

GET /admin/payments/reconciliation – Reconciliation issues (amount mismatch, duplicates, stale, missing, orphan events)
POST /admin/payments/reconciliation/run – Run reconciliation now
POST /admin/payments/reconciliation/{id}/resolve – Resolve an issue (note required, audited)
GET /admin/refunds – Refund queue

request.description: Filter status (comma list).

item.name: POST /admin/refunds/{id}/approve – Approve and execute a refund with the provider
POST /admin/refunds/{id}/reject – Reject a refund (reason required)
GET /admin/settlements – Settlement records (records only unless payouts are legally allowed)
POST /admin/settlements/generate – Generate settlements for a period (idempotent)
POST /admin/settlements/{id}/approve – Approve a DRAFT settlement
POST /admin/settlements/{id}/mark-paid – Record an off-platform payout for an APPROVED settlement
GET /admin/payments/dashboard – Reconciliation dashboard: pending / failed payments, captured amount, refunds to process, settlements, open issues by kind

POST /admin/users – Create an ADMIN account (super admin only)

request.description: The new admin is PENDING_VERIFICATION and becomes ACTIVE after enrolling TOTP at first login. Audited.

item.name: GET /admin/users – List users (filter, search, sort, paginate)

request.description: Audited (personal data access).

item.name: GET /admin/users/{id} – One account (contact, status, names, admin sub-roles) – never health data; audited
POST /admin/users/{id}/suspend – Suspend (reason required): sessions revoked, user notified, audited
POST /admin/users/{id}/reactivate – Reactivate (reason required): user notified, audited
PATCH /admin/users/{id}/status – Activate or suspend an account

request.description: Suspension revokes all sessions immediately. Admins cannot change other admins; nobody can change a super admin or themselves. Audited with reason.

item.name: PATCH /admin/users/{id}/role – Change a user role (super admin only)

request.description: Revokes all sessions of the user. SUPER_ADMIN cannot be granted. Audited with reason.

item.name: Admin – verification
GET /admin/verification/{kind} – Verification queue (oldest first; default status = pending)
GET /admin/verification/{kind}/{id} – Entity under review with its documents (open them with GET /files/:file_id/access-url – logged)
POST /admin/verification/{kind}/{id}/approve – Approve: entity VERIFIED, pending documents APPROVED, account ACTIVE, holder notified
POST /admin/verification/{kind}/{id}/reject – Reject with a reason (holder notified)
POST /admin/verification/{kind}/{id}/request-documents – Ask for more / new documents (listed types are marked REJECTED; pharmacies go back to DRAFT to resubmit)
Auth – devices & biometrics
POST /auth/devices – Register this device / enable biometric login

request.description: Upserts the device and BINDS the current session to it: from now on /auth/refresh for this session requires `device_id`. The app stores the refresh token in Keychain/Keystore behind OS biometrics. No biometric data is sent.

item.name: GET /auth/devices – List your registered devices
DELETE /auth/devices/{id} – Remove a device (disables biometrics, revokes its sessions)
Auth – login & sessions
POST /auth/login – Log in with email/phone + password

request.description: Returns tokens, or `mfa_required: true` + `mfa_token` when TOTP is needed (always for ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN; `mfa_setup_required: true` if they have not enrolled yet). After LOGIN_MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS (5) failures the account is locked for LOGIN_LOCKOUT_MINUTES (15). Errors are generic (no user enumeration).

item.name: POST /auth/login/otp – Log in with phone + SMS code

request.description: First call POST /auth/otp/request with purpose=LOGIN. Only verified phone numbers can log in this way.

item.name: POST /auth/login/mfa – Second login step: TOTP code

request.description: Use the mfa_token from /auth/login. Wrong codes count towards the lockout.

item.name: POST /auth/refresh – Rotate the refresh token

request.description: Each refresh token works ONCE. Re-using an already-rotated token is treated as theft: the whole session family is revoked (AUTH_REFRESH_REUSED) and the user must log in again. Device-bound sessions also need `device_id`.

item.name: POST /auth/logout – Revoke the current session
POST /auth/logout-all – Revoke every session of the account (including this one)
GET /auth/sessions – List active sessions

request.description: Paginated. `current: true` marks the session making the call.

item.name: DELETE /auth/sessions/{id} – Revoke one of your sessions (e.g. a lost phone)
Auth – MFA (TOTP)
POST /auth/mfa/setup – Start TOTP enrolment

request.description: Admins (mandatory) call this with the `mfa_token` from /auth/login; pharmacy staff (optional) call it with their Bearer token. Returns the secret + otpauth URL to show as QR code. Not available for other roles.

item.name: POST /auth/mfa/enable – Confirm TOTP enrolment with a code

request.description: With `mfa_token` (login flow) → returns tokens (admins created by a super admin become ACTIVE here). With Bearer → returns `{ mfa_enabled: true }`.

item.name: POST /auth/mfa/disable – Disable TOTP (pharmacy staff only)

request.description: Requires password + current code. Forbidden for ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN.

item.name: Auth – OTP
POST /auth/otp/request – Send a 6-digit code

request.description: REGISTER / LOGIN / RESET_PASSWORD are public and always answer 202 (no enumeration). LOGIN requires a phone target. VERIFY_PHONE / VERIFY_EMAIL require a Bearer token and your own phone/email. Codes expire after 5 min, allow 5 attempts, and can be re-requested after the cooldown (60 s).

item.name: POST /auth/otp/verify – Verify a code

request.description: REGISTER → marks the identifier verified (patients become ACTIVE) and returns tokens (or mfa_required). RESET_PASSWORD → returns `reset_token` for /auth/password/reset. VERIFY_* (Bearer) → `verified: true`. LOGIN codes must be used with /auth/login/otp.

item.name: Auth – password
POST /auth/password/forgot – Start a password reset

request.description: Sends a RESET_PASSWORD code to a VERIFIED email/phone. Always 202. Next: /auth/otp/verify then /auth/password/reset.

item.name: POST /auth/password/reset – Set a new password with a reset_token

request.description: Single use. Signs out ALL sessions and clears any lockout.

item.name: POST /auth/password/change – Change password (logged in)

request.description: Keeps the current session, signs out all others.

item.name: Auth – registration
POST /auth/register/patient – Register a patient

request.description: Always answers 202 with a masked target, whether or not the email/phone is already registered (no enumeration). A 6-digit code (purpose REGISTER) is sent to the phone (or email if no phone). Complete with POST /auth/otp/verify. The account becomes ACTIVE once the code is verified.

item.name: POST /auth/register/pharmacy – Register a pharmacy owner + pharmacy (DRAFT)

request.description: Always answers 202 with a masked target, whether or not the email/phone is already registered (no enumeration). A 6-digit code (purpose REGISTER) is sent to the phone (or email if no phone). Complete with POST /auth/otp/verify. The owner stays PENDING_VERIFICATION and the pharmacy DRAFT until documents are reviewed by an admin.

item.name: POST /auth/register/delivery-company – Register a delivery company admin + company

request.description: Always answers 202 with a masked target, whether or not the email/phone is already registered (no enumeration). A 6-digit code (purpose REGISTER) is sent to the phone (or email if no phone). Complete with POST /auth/otp/verify. Account and company stay PENDING_VERIFICATION until an admin approves them.

item.name: POST /auth/register/driver – Register an independent driver

request.description: Always answers 202 with a masked target, whether or not the email/phone is already registered (no enumeration). A 6-digit code (purpose REGISTER) is sent to the phone (or email if no phone). Complete with POST /auth/otp/verify. The driver stays PENDING_VERIFICATION until an admin approves the documents.

item.name: POST /auth/register/staff – Accept a pharmacy staff invitation (creates the account)

request.description: The email/phone comes from the invitation and is marked verified. Returns tokens immediately; the account stays PENDING_VERIFICATION until an admin approves it.

item.name: POST /auth/invitations/preview – Show who invited you before you register

request.description: Returns pharmacy name, role and masked target.

item.name: Catalog – medicines
GET /medicines/search – Search the medicine catalog (fr / ar / DCI, typo-tolerant)

request.description: Any authenticated user.

item.name: GET /medicines/{id} – Medicine detail
Complaints
POST /complaints – File a complaint

request.description: Reference CMP-YYYY-NNNNNN. Handled by support admins (Phase 9).

item.name: GET /complaints – Complaints I filed
GET /complaints/{id} – One of my complaints with its messages
POST /complaints/{id}/messages – Add a message to my complaint
Delivery – company
GET /delivery/company – My company profile, verification status and documents
POST /delivery/company/documents – Attach a verification document (file purpose DELIVERY_COMPANY_DOC)
GET /delivery/company/drivers – Drivers of my company
DELETE /delivery/company/drivers/{id} – Remove a driver from my company (not while carrying a parcel)
POST /delivery/company/invitations – Invite a driver by phone or email (company must be VERIFIED)
GET /delivery/company/invitations – Driver invitations of my company
DELETE /delivery/company/invitations/{id} – Revoke a pending invitation
GET /delivery/company/reports – Activity report: volumes by status, success rate, fees, payouts, per driver
Delivery – driver
GET /delivery/me – My driver profile, verification status, company, documents
POST /delivery/me/documents – Attach a verification document (file purpose DRIVER_DOC)
POST /delivery/invitations/accept – Join a delivery company with an invitation token

request.description: The token must have been sent to your own phone / email. Not possible while carrying a parcel.

item.name: PATCH /delivery/me/availability – Go online / offline (going online requires a verified driver)
PATCH /delivery/me/location – Update my position (throttled)

request.description: At most one update every driver_location_min_interval_seconds (429 DELIVERY_LOCATION_THROTTLED with details.retry_after_seconds). Streamed to the patient (socket event delivery.location) only while a job is OUT_FOR_DELIVERY.

item.name: GET /delivery/jobs/available – Job board

request.description: AVAILABLE jobs near you (radius_km from your last location) or filtered by destination wilaya/commune. Shows the pickup pharmacy, the destination AREA only, fee and payout. The full drop-off address is revealed after assignment.

item.name: GET /delivery/jobs/active – My current jobs (assigned, picked up, out for delivery, failed awaiting return)
GET /delivery/jobs/{id} – One job: full details if assigned to me, public card if still available
POST /delivery/jobs/{id}/accept – Accept a job (first come, first served)

request.description: Atomic with an optimistic lock: when two drivers accept at once, exactly one wins; the other gets 409 DELIVERY_ALREADY_TAKEN.

item.name: POST /delivery/jobs/{id}/release – Give a job back before pickup (reason; delivery_max_releases_per_day)
POST /delivery/jobs/{id}/confirm-pickup – ASSIGNED → PICKED_UP with the pharmacy pickup code (locked after delivery_code_max_attempts)
POST /delivery/jobs/{id}/start – PICKED_UP → OUT_FOR_DELIVERY (optional ETA)
POST /delivery/jobs/{id}/confirm-delivery – OUT_FOR_DELIVERY → DELIVERED with exactly one proof

request.description: delivery_code (patient OTP, locked after delivery_code_max_attempts) | signature_file_id | photo_file_id + photo_has_no_face=true (files uploaded with purpose PROOF_OF_DELIVERY). DELIVERED cannot be set without a valid proof.

item.name: POST /delivery/jobs/{id}/fail – PICKED_UP / OUT_FOR_DELIVERY → FAILED (reason, attempts); then bring the parcel back
POST /delivery/jobs/{id}/confirm-return – I brought the failed parcel back to the pharmacy (the pharmacy then confirms receipt)
GET /delivery/history – My finished jobs (delivered, failed, returned, cancelled)
GET /delivery/earnings – Payouts of delivered jobs per day (records only)
Delivery – onboarding
POST /delivery/register – Register a delivery company or an independent driver

request.description: account_type COMPANY → company admin + company (PENDING_VERIFICATION); DRIVER → independent driver (PENDING_VERIFICATION). Then verify the OTP, log in, upload documents (purpose DELIVERY_COMPANY_DOC / DRIVER_DOC) and attach them. An admin verifies the account; unverified drivers see no jobs.

item.name: Files
POST /files/upload – Upload files (JPEG / PNG / PDF)

request.description: multipart/form-data with `purpose` and one or more `files`. Type is detected from the file content (magic bytes), not the extension. Max FILE_MAX_SIZE_MB (10) per file, FILE_MAX_FILES (5) per call. Files are malware-scanned and encrypted at rest. A single invalid file rejects the whole batch. Purposes per role: PATIENT → PRESCRIPTION, CHIFA_CARD, MESSAGE_ATTACHMENT, DEPENDANT_PROOF; PHARMACY_OWNER/PHARMACIST → PHARMACY_DOC, MESSAGE_ATTACHMENT; ASSISTANT → MESSAGE_ATTACHMENT; DELIVERY_COMPANY_ADMIN → DELIVERY_COMPANY_DOC; DRIVER → DRIVER_DOC, PROOF_OF_DELIVERY.

item.name: GET /files/{id} – File metadata (if you may access it)
GET /files/{id}/access-url – Get a short-lived signed download link

request.description: Only for users authorized on this file (owner, recipient pharmacist/owner with patient consent, …). The link is valid FILE_URL_TTL_SECONDS (300 s). Every issuance is audited; prescription/CHIFA reads also go to sensitive_access_logs.

item.name: GET /files/download/{token} – Download through a signed link (no Bearer needed)

request.description: Returns the raw file (not the JSON envelope) with Cache-Control: no-store. Invalid/expired → 403 FILE_URL_INVALID (JSON).

item.name: Geo (reference data)
GET /geo/wilayas – List the 58 wilayas (public)
GET /geo/wilayas/{id}/communes – List communes of a wilaya (public)
Health
GET /health – Liveness + database connectivity
GET /health/live – Liveness (no dependency checked)
GET /ready – Readiness: database reachable and schema migrated
Me – privacy
POST /me/data-export – Download all my personal data (JSON)

request.description: Right of access / portability. Secrets and storage internals are excluded. At most once every 10 minutes; audited.

item.name: POST /me/delete-account – Delete my account (patients)

request.description: Re-authentication with the password + confirm=true. Refused while an order is in progress. Personal data is erased / anonymised; orders, payments, refunds, receipts, consent records and audit logs are kept as legally required records without contact details. All sessions end.

item.name: Me – profile & consents
GET /me – Current account
PATCH /me – Update preferences (language)
GET /me/consents – List your consent records (history included)
POST /me/consents – Grant a consent

request.description: Idempotent for the same type+version. TERMS/PRIVACY must use the current version.

item.name: DELETE /me/consents/{type} – Revoke a consent

request.description: HEALTH_DATA_PROCESSING and SHARE_PRESCRIPTION_WITH_PHARMACY can be revoked. TERMS/PRIVACY cannot (request account deletion instead).

item.name: Messaging
GET /conversations – My conversations

request.description: Patient: own conversations. Pharmacy staff: conversations of their pharmacy. Sorted by last message. Filter status, request_id.

item.name: GET /conversations/{id}/messages – Messages (cursor pagination, newest first)

request.description: Pass meta.cursor.next_cursor as `before` to load older messages; null = no more.

item.name: POST /conversations/{id}/messages – Send a message

request.description: CLARIFICATION_ANSWER (patient) brings the request back from CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED (to OFFER_AVAILABLE if an offer is pending, else AWAITING_PHARMACY_RESPONSE). Safety: max length, per-user rate limit, phone numbers and blocked words rejected (configurable), attachments must be MESSAGE_ATTACHMENT files you uploaded.

item.name: POST /conversations/{id}/read – Mark the other side’s messages as read
Notifications
GET /notifications – My in-app notifications

request.description: `meta.unread_count` gives the badge count.

item.name: POST /notifications/read-all – Mark all as read
POST /notifications/{id}/read – Mark one as read
GET /notifications/preferences – Channel preferences and muted types
PATCH /notifications/preferences – Update channel preferences / muted types
Offers (patient)
GET /requests/{id}/offers – Offers received for my request (cheapest first, drafts never shown)
GET /requests/{id}/offers/compare – Compare sent offers

request.description: Normalized totals (incl. effective total after rejected alternatives), missing / partial items, alternatives, preparation time, delivery, distance.

item.name: GET /offers/{id} – Offer detail (patient)
POST /offers/{id}/items/{itemId}/approval – Approve or reject a proposed substitution

request.description: Each alternative (patient_approval = PENDING) must be decided before the offer can be accepted (Phase 6). Rejected lines are excluded from the order.

item.name: Orders (patient)
POST /offers/{id}/accept – Accept an offer → creates the order

request.description: Offer must be SENT and unexpired, every substitution decided, items still allowed and in stock. Prices are frozen. Other offers are REJECTED, the request becomes OFFER_ACCEPTED. Initial status: PHARMACIST_VALIDATION_PENDING (validation first, default) or AWAITING_PAYMENT (payment first).

item.name: GET /orders – My orders

request.description: Filter status (comma list), from/to; sort created_at | updated_at.

item.name: GET /orders/{id} – Order detail (full patient view, incl. next_actions)
GET /orders/{id}/timeline – Order timeline with localized labels
POST /orders/{id}/cancel – Cancel my order

request.description: Free before payment capture (→ CANCELLED). After capture and before preparation → REFUND_PENDING. During preparation / ready / assigned → ORDER_CANCEL_REQUIRES_APPROVAL (ask the pharmacy or support). Never after the courier picked it up.

item.name: POST /orders/{id}/collection-code – Get a new collection code (pickup orders, READY_FOR_PICKUP)

request.description: Returned once; only its hash is stored. Resets wrong attempts.

item.name: GET /orders/{id}/delivery – Track my delivery

request.description: Status, driver first name and vehicle, ETA; live_location only while OUT_FOR_DELIVERY.

item.name: POST /orders/{id}/delivery/code – Get a new delivery code to give the driver (shown once; resets attempts)
Patients – profile, addresses, dependants
GET /patients/me – My patient profile
PATCH /patients/me – Update my profile

request.description: All fields optional. national_id is stored encrypted and returned masked.

request.description: Default address first, then by created_at (`order`).

item.name: POST /patients/me/addresses – Add an address

item.name: DELETE /patients/me/addresses/{id} – Delete an address (soft delete)

request.description: Past requests keep their frozen address snapshot.

item.name: POST /patients/me/addresses/{id}/default – Make this my default address
GET /patients/me/dependants – List my dependants
POST /patients/me/dependants – Declare a dependant

request.description: authorization_status starts DECLARED. Upload a proof (purpose DEPENDANT_PROOF) so an admin can set it to VERIFIED. Requests are allowed only for relationships in the platform setting `dependant_allowed_relationships`.

item.name: GET /patients/me/dependants/{id} – Get a dependant
PATCH /patients/me/dependants/{id} – Update a dependant

request.description: Changing identity fields or the proof resets authorization_status to DECLARED.

item.name: DELETE /patients/me/dependants/{id} – Remove a dependant (soft delete)
Payments – provider callbacks
POST /payments/webhook/{provider} – Provider webhook

request.description: Signature verified (mock: HMAC-SHA256 in x-mock-signature). Every event is stored in payment_events BEFORE processing; duplicate provider_event_id → 200 { duplicate: true }. Processing only triggers a server-side status check – the webhook body itself never confirms a payment.

item.name: GET /payments/return/{paymentId} – Browser return URL from the hosted page

request.description: Triggers a server-side verification and reports the resulting status.

item.name: POST /payments/mock/{providerOrderId}/simulate – [DEV/TEST] Simulate the bank result on the mock gateway

request.description: Disabled in production and with real providers.

GET /orders/{id}/checkout – Checkout summary

request.description: Lines, medicines subtotal, delivery fee, permitted service fee, total, deadline, provider, collection model.

item.name: POST /orders/{id}/pay – Start paying (redirect to the hosted payment page)

request.description: Order must be AWAITING_PAYMENT before its deadline. Creates a payment (amount from the server-side order), moves the order to PAYMENT_PENDING and returns `redirect_url`. The app opens it, then polls GET /payments/:id/status – a browser "success" never confirms a payment.

item.name: GET /orders/{id}/payments – Payments of my order
GET /payments/{id}/status – Payment status (poll after the redirect)

request.description: Each call re-checks a PENDING payment with the provider server-side.

item.name: GET /orders/{id}/receipt – Receipt (JSON, or PDF with ?format=pdf)

request.description: Issued automatically when the payment is CONFIRMED.

item.name: POST /orders/{id}/refund-request – Request a (partial) refund

request.description: Requires a confirmed payment. Admin approval executes it with the provider.

item.name: GET /orders/{id}/refunds – Refunds of my order

POST /pharmacies/register – Register a pharmacy (owner + pharmacy in PENDING_VERIFICATION)

request.description: Same as POST /auth/register/pharmacy. Then: verify the OTP, log in, upload documents (purpose PHARMACY_DOC) and attach them with POST /pharmacy/documents. An admin reviews the documents; the pharmacy cannot receive requests until VERIFIED.

item.name: GET /pharmacies/nearby – Verified pharmacies near a point (public)

request.description: Public fields only. Sorted by distance. open_now uses Algiers local time and on-duty (garde) periods.

item.name: Pharmacies – staff
POST /pharmacies/{id}/staff/invite – Invite a pharmacist or assistant (owner only)

request.description: Pharmacy must be VERIFIED. Sends an invitation token by SMS/email (expires after STAFF_INVITATION_TTL_DAYS = 7). The invitee completes POST /auth/register/staff. A new invitation to the same person revokes the previous one.

DELETE /pharmacies/{id}/staff/invitations/{invitationId} – Revoke a pending invitation (owner only)
Pharmacy – complaints
GET /pharmacy/complaints – Complaints against my pharmacy (OWNER, PHARMACIST)
GET /pharmacy/complaints/{id} – Complaint detail (OWNER, PHARMACIST)
POST /pharmacy/complaints/{id}/reply – Reply to a complaint (OWNER, PHARMACIST)
Pharmacy – offers
POST /pharmacy/requests/{id}/offers – Create a DRAFT offer (all staff; substitutions OWNER/PHARMACIST only)

request.description: All amounts are computed by the server: line_total = unit × quantity_offered (0 if UNAVAILABLE), subtotal, delivery fee from delivery_fee_rules (never from the client), service fee from settings. Items in restricted categories are refused. One active offer per pharmacy and request.

item.name: GET /pharmacy/offers – My pharmacy offers

request.description: Filter by status (comma list).

item.name: GET /pharmacy/offers/{id} – Offer detail
PATCH /pharmacy/offers/{id} – Replace a DRAFT offer (same body as create)
POST /pharmacy/offers/{id}/send – Send the offer to the patient

request.description: DRAFT → SENT; recipient → OFFERED; request → OFFER_AVAILABLE. Sent by OWNER/PHARMACIST, linked request items are marked confirmed_by_pharmacist.

item.name: POST /pharmacy/offers/{id}/withdraw – Withdraw a DRAFT or SENT offer
Pharmacy – orders
GET /pharmacy/orders – Orders of my pharmacy (all staff)
GET /pharmacy/orders/{id} – Order detail (pharmacy view: patient first name, delivery area only)
GET /pharmacy/orders/{id}/timeline – Order timeline
POST /pharmacy/orders/{id}/validate – Pharmacist validation (OWNER/PHARMACIST only)

request.description: Explicit decision with `confirm: true` and a note. APPROVE: validation-first → AWAITING_PAYMENT (payment deadline starts); payment-first → PREPARING. REJECT: validation-first → CANCELLED; payment-first → REFUND_PENDING.

item.name: POST /pharmacy/orders/{id}/start-preparing – PAYMENT_CONFIRMED → PREPARING (validation-first)
POST /pharmacy/orders/{id}/ready – PREPARING → READY_FOR_PICKUP

request.description: Pickup: the patient receives a collection code. Delivery: a delivery job is created (pickup code for the pharmacy, delivery code for the patient).

item.name: POST /pharmacy/orders/{id}/handover – Pickup hand-over: READY_FOR_PICKUP → COMPLETED with the patient collection code (5 attempts)
POST /pharmacy/orders/{id}/cancel – Cancel an order (OWNER/PHARMACIST) – refund flow when already paid
POST /pharmacy/orders/{id}/refund-request – Request a partial refund (e.g. item unavailable after payment) – OWNER/PHARMACIST
GET /pharmacy/orders/{id}/delivery – Delivery of one of my orders (driver first name, vehicle, plate, timestamps)
POST /pharmacy/orders/{id}/delivery/pickup-code – New pickup code to show the driver (shown once; resets attempts)
POST /pharmacy/orders/{id}/delivery/confirm-return – Confirm the failed parcel is back: delivery RETURNED, order FAILED → REFUND_PENDING (automatic refund request)
Pharmacy – profile, hours, staff, verification
GET /pharmacy/me – My pharmacy (any staff role; also while pending verification)
PATCH /pharmacy/me – Update my pharmacy (OWNER)

request.description: Legal fields (legal_name, authorization_number, tax_id_nif, commercial_register_rc) are locked once VERIFIED.

item.name: GET /pharmacy/opening-hours – Weekly opening hours
PUT /pharmacy/opening-hours – Replace the weekly opening hours (OWNER, PHARMACIST)
GET /pharmacy/on-duty – Upcoming on-duty (garde) periods
POST /pharmacy/on-duty – Add an on-duty period (OWNER, PHARMACIST)

request.description: Max 14 days, must end in the future.

item.name: DELETE /pharmacy/on-duty/{id} – Delete an on-duty period (OWNER, PHARMACIST)
GET /pharmacy/service-areas – Service areas (where the pharmacy receives requests / delivers)
POST /pharmacy/service-areas – Add a service area (OWNER)
PUT /pharmacy/service-areas/{id} – Replace a service area (OWNER)
DELETE /pharmacy/service-areas/{id} – Delete a service area (OWNER)
GET /pharmacy/payout-accounts – Payout accounts (OWNER) – numbers always masked
POST /pharmacy/payout-accounts – Add a payout account (OWNER)

request.description: Stored encrypted; `verified` is set by finance admins.

item.name: DELETE /pharmacy/payout-accounts/{id} – Remove a payout account (OWNER)
GET /pharmacy/verification – Verification status, rejection reason, documents and what is missing
POST /pharmacy/verification/submit – (Re)submit for verification (OWNER)

request.description: From DRAFT or REJECTED, once AUTHORIZATION, PHARMACIST_DIPLOMA and ID documents are uploaded (pending or approved).

item.name: GET /pharmacy/documents – Verification documents (OWNER, PHARMACIST)
POST /pharmacy/documents – Attach a document (OWNER)

request.description: Upload the file first with purpose PHARMACY_DOC.

item.name: DELETE /pharmacy/documents/{id} – Remove a pending/rejected document (OWNER)
GET /pharmacy/staff – List staff (OWNER)
POST /pharmacy/staff/invite – Invite a pharmacist or assistant (OWNER)

request.description: Same as POST /pharmacies/:id/staff/invite.

item.name: PATCH /pharmacy/staff/{staffId} – Change role / deactivate a staff member (OWNER)

request.description: PHARMACIST requires a license number. Role changes and deactivation revoke the member’s sessions immediately.

item.name: Pharmacy – reports & settlements
GET /pharmacy/reports/summary – Activity summary (OWNER, PHARMACIST)

request.description: Requests received by recipient status, average response time, offers sent/accepted, conversion, orders by status, revenue (DELIVERED + COMPLETED, centimes).

item.name: GET /pharmacy/settlements – Settlement records (OWNER)

request.description: Records only unless the payout model is legally confirmed (see Phase 7).

item.name: Pharmacy – request inbox
GET /pharmacy/requests – Requests received by my pharmacy (all staff)

request.description: Filter recipient_status, request_status, urgency, from/to (received). URGENT first, then sort sent_at | expires_at.

item.name: GET /pharmacy/requests/{id} – Request detail (all staff)

request.description: Patient first name only, items, file ids, delivery area. Prescription files are viewable through /files/:id/access-url ONLY by OWNER/PHARMACIST with the patient consent active (can_view_prescription). Marks the request VIEWED and writes a sensitive_access_log.

item.name: POST /pharmacy/requests/{id}/accept-interest – Signal interest (all staff)

request.description: Recipient → INTERESTED. Does NOT authorize dispensing, does NOT create an order or an offer.

item.name: POST /pharmacy/requests/{id}/decline – Decline the request (OWNER, PHARMACIST)

request.description: Withdraw a sent offer first. Draft offers are discarded.

item.name: POST /pharmacy/requests/{id}/clarification – Ask the patient a question (OWNER, PHARMACIST)

request.description: Creates the conversation if needed, posts a CLARIFICATION_QUESTION message, request → CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED.

item.name: Pharmacy – stock
GET /pharmacy/stock – My stock (all staff)

request.description: Filter stock_status, q; sort updated_at | brand_name.

item.name: PUT /pharmacy/stock/{medicineId} – Set stock for a medicine (all staff, upsert)
DELETE /pharmacy/stock/{medicineId} – Remove a stock line (OWNER, PHARMACIST)
POST /pharmacy/stock/import – Bulk stock import from CSV (OWNER, PHARMACIST)

request.description: Header: `medicine_id` or `regulatory_code`, `stock_status` (IN_STOCK|LOW|OUT_OF_STOCK), `quantity`, `unit_price_centimes`. `,` or `;` separated, UTF-8. Returns a validation report; invalid lines are skipped. `dry_run=true` validates only.

item.name: Requests (patient)
POST /requests/preview-matching – Preview which pharmacies would receive the request

request.description: Call before the final submit so the patient sees the pharmacies. Same rules as POST /requests.

item.name: POST /requests – Submit a request (PRESCRIPTION, CHIFA or PRODUCT)

request.description: Creates the request (reference RX-YYYY-NNNNNN), the share-consent record and one recipient per matched pharmacy, then moves it to AWAITING_PHARMACY_RESPONSE. Rejects restricted medicine categories (REQUEST_CATEGORY_RESTRICTED). CHIFA data is stored but coverage is NOT verified unless an official CNAS integration exists. OCR (if enabled) adds advisory items later (source=OCR).

item.name: GET /requests – My requests

request.description: Filter by status (comma list), request_type, from/to. Sort created_at | expires_at.

item.name: GET /requests/{id} – Request detail

request.description: Includes recipients' statuses, items (incl. OCR suggestions) and a summary of sent offers.

item.name: POST /requests/{id}/cancel – Cancel a request

request.description: Allowed while open (no order yet). If an order exists, cancel the order instead (REQUEST_HAS_ORDER).

item.name: POST /requests/{id}/items – Add an item

request.description: Only while REQUEST_SUBMITTED / AWAITING_PHARMACY_RESPONSE / CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED.

item.name: PATCH /requests/{id}/items/{itemId} – Edit an item (e.g. correct an OCR suggestion)

request.description: Edited OCR items become source=PATIENT. Pharmacist-confirmed items are locked.

item.name: DELETE /requests/{id}/items/{itemId} – Remove an item
